title: Gym CRM AC-29
description: Acceptance criterion AC-29 of the Gym CRM (milestone M5).

acceptanceCriteria.text: Simulated scans through the API: a pair of the customer and the right PT within 15 minutes and the pairing window turns the session to *Đã tập* and triggers the session taken, the PT credit, and the email; a missing side hangs the session with the right reason; a scan with no booking is an error; a customer training twice with two PTs needs a pair for each (D-069, D-070).
